summary: No box yet (00:51 UTC): the budget pace allowed no rental at the start, then one box fleet-wide, and under the 1.2 $/h cap (23:40) two other branches' boxes leave 0.24 $/h, which no offer passing the query fits. Built and tested --auto-spine (python/surfgym/autospine.py + train_fast.py, tests/python/test_auto_spine.py: 9 unit + 3 CPU trainer tests): round 2's hand-driven search->curriculum loop inside one launch - after a greedy eval with a quorum at the success line, beam_tas runs as a subprocess on the current weights; the frontier line, cut at its deepest CONTACT (never inside the fall that ends it), replaces the spine when it reaches past the greedy's own; a Go-Explore exact-chain fallback, a stall re-cut and exponential backoff. Gate 8 (the 20.4% catch) measured locally: the policy leaves its last ramp with vz +336 / h 3,609 where the record (analysis only) has +475 / 3,751 and lands on a ramp 70 u higher; three searches from the policy's own line (two GE runs, a yaw-temperature beam) find nothing past it - an energy gate carried from the start room (the policy's air strafing is 78% of optimal). Plan when a box frees: resume the incumbent with round 2's beam12 flags + --auto-spine. Incumbent 20.414 (pbr2b3).
